purpose: Documents random active-set/deal rules. Browser guest bots fill empty seats but never reserve or pre-claim roles.

flow.lobby: Humans and optional frontend guest bots occupy seats only.
flow.start: The tested backend builds and shuffles the active set, deals one Starting Card per player, and keeps three Hammock cards.
flow.bots: After game.start, each bot reads only its own authoritative startingRole and loads the matching specialized role brain.
flow.cardMovement: Starting Role never mutates; Current Card and player-bound statuses remain separate.
